kinds: computed by the validation project from JRC's and FEMA's files

fema.title: FEMA 1 percent zone (A or V), share of the cell
fema.semantics: share of the cell's pixels whose centre lies in a FEMA A or V zone; the same at every return period

jrc.title: Flooded land in JRC's map, share of the cell
jrc.semantics: share of the cell's pixels with a published depth at this return period, permanent water left out

jrc_only.title: Flooded in JRC's map, outside FEMA's 1 percent zone
jrc_only.semantics: share of the cell's pixels flooded at this return period and outside FEMA's A and V zones

fema_only.title: In FEMA's 1 percent zone, dry in JRC's map
fema_only.semantics: share of the cell's pixels in a FEMA A or V zone with no published depth at this return period, permanent water left out

water.title: JRC's permanent water, share of the cell
water.semantics: share of the cell's pixels in the publisher's permanent-water layer; the same at every return period
